name: airsense-diwali
description: AI-powered neighborhood-level air pollution prediction around Diwali

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @airsense/api && npm run build -w @airsense/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @airsense/api" "npm run dev -w @airsense/web"
scripts.evaluate: npm run build:shared && npm run evaluate -w @airsense/api
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @airsense/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @airsense/api && npm run typecheck -w @airsense/web
